# NeoRV32 (third-party)

NeoRV32 is **not rewritten** in this repository. The CPU is consumed as a
Vivado catalog IP; firmware `#include`s its public C headers.

- Upstream: https://github.com/stnolting/neorv32
- License: BSD-3-Clause (verbatim copy in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE))
- SPDX: `BSD-3-Clause`

Original PVLA / LA / platform files in this repo are MIT. See the root
[`LICENSE`](../../LICENSE) and the README license section.
